title: docs code cleanup: Do not add generated .md files for man pages
body:
Cleanup previously checked in .md files for man pages. Update .gitignore to ignore the previously committed files.
Location: [docs/source/markdown](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/tree/main/docs/source/markdown)

Ref https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/30251#discussion_r4587420424

comments.body: Closing as not needed. On main, only the `.md.in` sources are committed: their generated `.md` files are all listed in `docs/source/markdown/.gitignore`, and the committed plain `.md` pages (e.g. `podman-manifest.1.md`) are hand-written sources. The only wrongly committed file was `podman-manifest-list.1.md` in #30251, which is being fixed there.
